title: Anthropic to launch new ‘Claude Mythos’ model with advanced reasoning features - SiliconANGLE
summary: Anthropic PBC accidentally revealed its new, more capable language model, Claude Mythos, which is expected to be pricier and more advanced than its current offerings, potentially impacting the cybersecurity vulnerability detection market.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses a configuration error leading to the revelation of a new, advanced model that could outperform existing products and raises concerns about competition in the vulnerability detection market, indicating negative market sentiment.
